fact: On 25 April 2024 the DGDDL director said SYGIDAN-RECETTES, centralising revenue data from all actors with traceability of each collection, was in pre-validation, to be distributed to all collectivités from January 2025, with the pilot phase to be deployed in 22 communes; PAMREC is financed by the AfDB and the State (3,003,901,293 FCFA).
title: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ Vers la digitalisation des recettes fiscales des communes
